resolved_setup_issues: Playwright was initially absent; installed playwright@1.63.0 globally and reran sync successfully.
Supplied hook symlinks initially resolved Husky h beside the symlink. A Git-metadata-only h trampoline now re-enters each original hook path, preserving repository hooks and co-author cleanup.

The first browser navigation waited for networkidle and timed out because background connections stayed active. The completed proof uses DOMContentLoaded and waits for fonts; no requests or application paths were mocked.
local_runtime_limitations: Next start lacks Cloudflare caches and local page_views migration for background analytics; the rendered product page and listing feed both returned HTTP 200. This round does not claim hosted analytics qualification.
